meta.name: linkedin-employee-advocacy
meta.description: Stand up and run a LinkedIn employee advocacy program for a marketing or sales team. Covers 14-day launch playbook, brand-guideline governance, per-post time budget, cadence benchmarks, and team ROI (reach, engagement, pipeline). Triggers on "employee advocacy", "get the team posting", "scale LinkedIn across team", "advocacy ROI". Not for planning one person's own calendar (use linkedin-content-planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把团队成员的个人发帖组织成有节奏、可衡量的品牌传播计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果市场或销售团队想在领英上统一发声并衡量效果
copy.tagline_en: Turn teammates' personal posts into a steady, measurable brand broadcast program
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a marketing or sales team wants consistent posting and measurable reach on LinkedIn

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为营销或销售团队搭建 LinkedIn 员工倡导项目：输出 14 天启动计划、运营模型（选题、审核、发文、测量）、每人发文节奏目标、KPI 面板规范，以及品牌安全治理手册。
howto.when: 当你要让团队在 LinkedIn 发文、启动倡导项目，或团队发文不一致时触发，也响应 “employee advocacy”、“advocacy ROI” 等说法。不用于规划单个人的内容日历。

say.text: 帮我给 10 人的营销团队做一个 14 天 LinkedIn 启动计划
say.note: 输出逐日安排与每人发文节奏目标

say.text: 设计团队倡导的 KPI 面板，含触达、互动和商机归因
say.note: 给出每人指标与团队级指标清单

say.text: 写一份品牌安全治理手册：哪些内容要审、哪些不用审
say.note: 含审核范围与 4 小时 SLA

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs a LinkedIn employee-advocacy program for a marketing or sales team: a 14-day launch plan, operating model (ideation, review, posting, measurement), per-member cadence targets, a KPI dashboard spec, and a brand-safety governance playbook.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a team posting on LinkedIn, are launching an advocacy program, or when team output is inconsistent; also responds to "employee advocacy", "advocacy ROI". Not for planning one person's own calendar.

say_en.text: Build a 14-day LinkedIn launch plan for my 10-person marketing team
say_en.note: Outputs day-by-day steps and cadence targets

say_en.text: Design a team advocacy KPI dashboard with reach, engagement and pipeline attribution
Write a brand-safety governance playbook: what marketing reviews and what it does not
